name: Lisa Mazzone
party: Les VERT-E-S / Grüne Schweiz (Green Party of Switzerland)
bio: Lisa Mazzone (born 25 January 1988 in Geneva) is a Swiss politician of the Green Party. She sat on the Grand Council of Geneva from 2013 to 2015, was a member of the National Council for Geneva from 2015 to 2019, where she was at the time the youngest member of the Swiss federal parliament, and then a member of the Council of States for Geneva from 2019 to 2023. She lost her Council of States seat in the second round of the October 2023 federal election, leaving the chamber at the end of 2023. In April 2024 she was elected president of the Green Party of Switzerland, succeeding Balthasar Glättli, becoming the only French-speaking politician then heading a Swiss national party.
